Elements.Script: getgenv().AutoCollectLoot = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoCollectLoot', {Title = 'Auto Collect Loot', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCollectLoot = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyPlot() local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if not plots then return nil end; for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId') or plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserid') or plot:GetAttribute('Owner'); if ownerId and (tonumber(ownerId) == lp.UserId or tostring(ownerId) == tostring(lp.UserId) or tostring(ownerId) == lp.Name) then return plot end end; return nil end; while getgenv().AutoCollectLoot do local myPlot = getMyPlot(); if myPlot then local lootSpawned = myPlot:FindFirstChild('LootSpawned'); if lootSpawned then for _, item in ipairs(lootSpawned:GetDescendants()) do if not getgenv().AutoCollectLoot then break end; if item.Parent and (item:IsA('Model') or item:IsA('BasePart')) then local nameLower = item.Name:lower(); if nameLower:match('^loot') then local num = tonumber(nameLower:match('%d+')); if num then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end); pcall(function() for _, wItem in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if wItem.Name:lower() == nameLower then wItem:Destroy() end end end); pcall(function() local ohTable1 = {[1] = num}; game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').RemoteEvents.LootPickup:FireServer(ohTable1) end) end end end end end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoCollectMoney = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoCollectMoney', {Title = 'Auto Collect Money', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCollectMoney = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyPlot() local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if not plots then return nil end; for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId') or plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserid') or plot:GetAttribute('Owner'); if ownerId and (tonumber(ownerId) == lp.UserId or tostring(ownerId) == tostring(lp.UserId) or tostring(ownerId) == lp.Name) then return plot end end; return nil end; while getgenv().AutoCollectMoney do local myPlot = getMyPlot(); local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if myPlot and root then local sell = myPlot:FindFirstChild('Sell'); local collectBtn = sell and sell:FindFirstChild('CollectButton'); local button = collectBtn and collectBtn:FindFirstChild('Button'); if button and button:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest') then firetouchinterest(root, button, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, button, 1) end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

local buttonNames = {}; local buttonMap = {}; local nameToRealName = {}; local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if plots then for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local buttons = plot:FindFirstChild('Buttons'); if buttons then for _, btn in ipairs(buttons:GetChildren()) do if btn.Name ~= 'ButtonMerge' then local amount = btn:GetAttribute('BuyAmount') or btn:GetAttribute('Price') or btn:GetAttribute('Cost'); if amount then local label = tostring(amount); if not buttonMap[label] then buttonMap[label] = true; table.insert(buttonNames, label); nameToRealName[label] = btn.Name end end end end end end end; table.sort(buttonNames, function(a, b) return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b) end); local defaultVal = buttonNames[1]; getgenv().SelectedBuyButton = defaultVal and nameToRealName[defaultVal]; Value:AddDropdown('BuyButtonDrop', {Title = 'Buy', Values = buttonNames, Multi = false, Default = defaultVal, Callback = function(v) local selected = type(v) == 'table' and v[1] or v; getgenv().SelectedBuyButton = nameToRealName[selected] or selected end}); getgenv().AutoBuySelected = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoBuySelected', {Title = 'Auto Buy Selected', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoBuySelected = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyPlot() local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if not plots then return nil end; for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId') or plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserid') or plot:GetAttribute('Owner'); if ownerId and (tonumber(ownerId) == lp.UserId or tostring(ownerId) == tostring(lp.UserId) or tostring(ownerId) == lp.Name) then return plot end end; return nil end; while getgenv().AutoBuySelected do local myPlot = getMyPlot(); local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local btnName = getgenv().SelectedBuyButton; if myPlot and root and btnName then local buttons = myPlot:FindFirstChild('Buttons'); local targetBtn = buttons and buttons:FindFirstChild(btnName); local button = targetBtn and targetBtn:FindFirstChild('Button'); if button and button:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest') then firetouchinterest(root, button, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, button, 1) end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoMerge = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoMerge', {Title = 'Auto Merge', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoMerge = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyPlot() local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots'); if not plots then return nil end; for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId') or plot:GetAttribute('OwnerUserid') or plot:GetAttribute('Owner'); if ownerId and (tonumber(ownerId) == lp.UserId or tostring(ownerId) == tostring(lp.UserId) or tostring(ownerId) == lp.Name) then return plot end end; return nil end; while getgenv().AutoMerge do local myPlot = getMyPlot(); local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if myPlot and root then local buttons = myPlot:FindFirstChild('Buttons'); local targetBtn = buttons and buttons:FindFirstChild('ButtonMerge'); local button = targetBtn and targetBtn:FindFirstChild('Button'); if button and button:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest') then firetouchinterest(root, button, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, button, 1) end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoCollectChest = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoCollectChest', {Title = 'Auto Collect Chest', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCollectChest = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getTargetChest() for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if obj.Name:sub(1, 5) == 'Chest' and obj:FindFirstChild('Hitbox') then return obj end end return nil end; while getgenv().AutoCollectChest do local chestGui = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('ChestGui'); local chestInfo = chestGui and chestGui:FindFirstChild('ChestInfo'); local isVisible = chestInfo and chestInfo.Visible; if not isVisible then local chest = getTargetChest(); if chest then local hitbox = chest:FindFirstChild('Hitbox'); local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if hitbox and root then local oldCFrame = hitbox.CFrame; hitbox.CFrame = root.CFrame; task.wait(1) end end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoUnlockChest = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoUnlockChest', {Title = 'Auto Unlock Chest', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoUnlockChest = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function parseNumber(str) if not str then return 0 end; str = str:gsub('[%$,%s]', ''):upper(); local mult = 1; if str:sub(-1) == 'K' then mult = 1000; str = str:sub(1, -2) elseif str:sub(-1) == 'M' then mult = 1000000; str = str:sub(1, -2) elseif str:sub(-1) == 'B' then mult = 1000000000; str = str:sub(1, -2) elseif str:sub(-1) == 'T' then mult = 1000000000000; str = str:sub(1, -2) end; return (tonumber(str) or 0) * mult end; while getgenv().AutoUnlockChest do local chestGui = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('ChestGui'); local chestInfo = chestGui and chestGui:FindFirstChild('ChestInfo'); if chestInfo and chestInfo.Visible then local priceFrame = chestInfo:FindFirstChild('UnlockMenu') and chestInfo.UnlockMenu:FindFirstChild('PriceFrame'); local itemPrice = priceFrame and priceFrame:FindFirstChild('ItemPrice'); local currencyGui = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('CurrencyGui'); local cashText = currencyGui and currencyGui:FindFirstChild('Frame') and currencyGui.Frame:FindFirstChild('CashText'); if itemPrice and cashText then local cost = parseNumber(itemPrice.Text); local myCash = parseNumber(cashText.Text); if myCash >= cost then game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').RemoteEvents.UnlockChest:FireServer() end end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoDiscardChest = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoDiscardChest', {Title = 'Auto Discard Chest', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoDiscardChest = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; while getgenv().AutoDiscardChest do local chestGui = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('ChestGui'); local chestInfo = chestGui and chestGui:FindFirstChild('ChestInfo'); if chestInfo and chestInfo.Visible then game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').RemoteEvents.DiscardChest:FireServer() end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})
